claims.claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows by setting control-plane architecture across multi-agent orchestration and deterministic route-policy dispatch.
Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting workflow value to reusable commercialization and usage-based forecasting.
Strengthened production reliability with audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows through evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
Accelerated the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks by standardizing managed workflow orchestration, replayable runtime design, and exit disposition governance.
Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data paths feeding vector services.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a disciplined operating model.
